newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit National sees banking income lower.
newsitem.headline: Credit National sees banking income lower.

text.p: Credit National-BFCE bank said in a statement on Tuesday it expected its gross banking income to be five percent lower in 1996 compared to a year ago.
But it added the banking income would be slightly higher than had been expected in its three-year plan established last summer.
Chairman Emmanuel Rodocanachi told Les Echos newspaper that the bank could participate in a restructuring of the French banking sector.

"Under certain conditions it would be useful for the company to participate in the restructuring which is emerging in the French banking sector after the major item which was the merger with BFCE," he said.
He said such a project needed to make industrial sense and the partner had to be "solid and powerful". He did not exclude a foreign partner.
